title: RS_Min
description: Returns the pixel-wise minimum of one band of two rasters.
kernels:
  - returns: raster
    args: [raster, raster]
  - returns: raster
    args:
    - raster
    - raster
    - name: band
      type: int
      description: Band index (1-based, default 1). A null or out-of-range index returns null.
---

::: callout-warning
**Experimental.** This function is experimental; its behavior may change without notice.
:::

## Description

Computes the pixel-wise minimum of one band of two rasters, analogous to `LEAST` for scalar values. Both
rasters must share the same dimension names, shape, data type, and nodata value for the selected band.

A pixel equal to the band's nodata value is treated as absent rather than as a comparable number: the other
raster's value wins outright, and a pixel that is nodata in both rasters stays nodata.

See [RS_Min_Agg](rs_min_agg.qmd) for the equivalent aggregate across rows.

## Examples

```sql
SELECT RS_Min(RS_Example(), RS_Example());
SELECT RS_Min(RS_Example(), RS_Example(), 2);
```
